author: jsign
content:
New zkEVM test release: [tests-zkevm@v21.0.6](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.6).

This release adds 116 EIP-8025 test cases, growing the suite from 182 to 298 (+64%), and a little extra spec check.
Won't go into much details here since would be too long, so I recommend seeing the full [release description](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.6), which has more details and linked PRs.

Thanks a lot in particular to <@761154847432769577> and <@126385519469789184>  for helping on more test coverage!
